chezmoi dotfiles: source `~/.local/share/chezmoi/`, target `~/`; apply with `chezmoi apply` (copies, not symlinks). Files in `~/` that are managed by chezmoi should NEVER be edited directly. Always edit the source in `~/.local/share/chezmoi/` or use `chezmoi edit`.
`chezmoi managed | grep <filename>`
`chezmoi edit ~/.zshrc`
`chezmoi add ~/.newfile`
`git add . && git commit -m "message" && git push`
Scripts: `~/.local/bin/`; `chmod +x ~/.local/bin/[script-name]`; `chezmoi add ~/.local/bin/[script-name]`; stored as `dot_local/bin/executable_[script-name]`. Add `export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"` to `.zshrc` if needed. Script names should NOT have `.sh` extension.
Bash template: `dot_config/opencode/skill/bash/scripts/pref_bash_script_template.sh`; `set -euo pipefail`; functions `fct_*`, logging `log_*`, constants `UPPER_CASE`, locals `lower_case`.
Files containing `{{ .variable }}` MUST have `.tmpl` extension. `chezmoi cat ~/.zshrc`
NEVER run bare cass — it launches an interactive TUI. Always use --robot or --json.
`cass search "authentication error" --robot --limit 5`
`cass view /path/to/session.jsonl -n 42 --json`
`cass expand /path/to/session.jsonl -n 42 -C 3 --json`
`cass capabilities --json`
`cass robot-docs guide`
Before solving a problem from scratch, check if any agent already solved something similar. stdout = data only, stderr = diagnostics. Exit 0 = success.
